lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 5-6 parallel horizontal rows extending from the post-branchial region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge feature in the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical transition from high-intensity pixels on top to lower-intensity shadow pixels below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs distributed across the leading edge and mid-section of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette consistent with a remora is visible ventrally to the mid-flank, posterior to the pectoral fin.
